name: Idol of Thruldana
description: Place into an empty Augment Socket in a Martial Weapon or a Sceptre to apply its effect to that item. Once socketed it cannot be retrieved but can be replaced by other Augment items.

lines: Targets can be affected by +1 of your Poisons at the same time
Allies in your Presence deal 13 to 27 added Attack Chaos Damage
